chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"And the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you."
He عليه السلام said: "It means grains."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْكِتَابَ: the Scripture, meaning the People of the Book
key_terms.طَعَامُ: food, here referring to what is meant by the verse
key_terms.قَوْلِ: the statement or saying being interpreted

ai.seo_question: What does "the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you" mean according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that the Quranic phrase about the food of the People of the Book refers to grains. This clarification gives the verse a specific legal meaning in the context of halal and haram food.
